_about: Public-domain Matthias Loy (1828-1915), Ohio Synod Lutheran theologian and hymn writer, president of Capital University, for the Word Hoard: The Doctrine of Justification (1882), Sermons on the Gospels (1888), Story of My Life (1905) and The Sermon on the Mount (1909), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

loy-justification: The doctrine of justification (Columbus, O., The Lutheran Book Concern, 1882)
loy-sermons-on-gospels: Sermons on the Gospels for the Sundays and CHief Festivals of the Church Year (catalogued 1888)
loy-story-of-my-life: Story of my life (Columbus, O., Lutheran book concern, 1905)
loy-sermon-on-the-mount: The Sermon on the mount : a practical study of chapters V-VII of St. Matthew's Gospel (Columbus, Ohio : Lutheran Book Concern, 1909)

_excluded.loy-other: The Life and Deeds of Dr. Martin Luther (1869, Fick's book, Loy only translated)
